{'translation': 'Two independent bookstores,留下書舍 (Liu Hsia Bookhouse) and 田園書屋 (Garden Bookstore), were raided by national security police the day before yesterday (the 15th), and arrests were made. It is understood that three people from 留下書舍 and two from 田園書屋 were arrested on suspicion of committing the offence of sedition under Article 23 of the Basic Law.', 'replaced': False}

{'translation': 'In a government press release, it was stated that the National Security Department of the police, having received a referral from the Customs and Excise Department, investigated and arrested five people at two bookstores in Mong Kok on suspicion of violating Section 24 of the 《維護國家安全條例》(Safeguarding National Security Ordinance), namely the offence of "doing acts with seditious intent with a seditious intent," and confiscated a batch of books.'}
